target.description: Original scientific target is the relationship of local synaptic coactivity and dendrite-coincident activity to subsequent spine structural plasticity in apical versus basal dendrites, including compartment-specific Kir manipulations; the bounded legacy component reconstructs four pooled correlations.

dataset.description: Wright et al. processed data/code archive at Zenodo 15047046; equivalence of the currently selected release to manuscript-linked release and detailed source-row provenance remains unresolved.

cohort.description: Figures 2–3 early-training population: apical 375 classified spines in 19 dendrites/10 mice and basal 366 spines in 17 dendrites/12 mice. These nested counts are biological samples, not independently held-out prediction cases.

split.description: The selected paper panels report associations across the observed early-training population, not a training/validation/test prediction split. Creating a held-out-mouse split would define a new extension.

inputs.description: Observed local coactivity, dendrite-coincident activity and baseline/follow-up structural spine measurements. The observed structural outcome enters the association calculation and cannot be a candidate predictor in a new forecasting task.

preprocessing.description: Local-neighbor coactivity, compartment inclusion and structural-change definitions are described in the source, but full supplementary-method and release-version equivalence for the processed feature calculations is not resolved by this review.

metric.description: Pearson correlation and inferential comparisons describe the biological association. There is no defensible direction in which altering a true correlation, a plasticity effect, or its p value constitutes better task performance.

aggregation.description: Paper panels pool spine observations and report compartment-specific summaries; spines are nested in dendrites and mice. This is an association estimand, not an aggregate model-accuracy ranking.

full_panel.description: Original association and Kir intervention findings plus all required released numerical companions: control behavior, Kir behavior, EM, Figures 1–4 (including numerical S11), S2–S4, S5 with both MRN=True and False, and S6–S10/S12. Existing full18 source requires all 18 families, 294 numerical call-site slots, all preparation quantities, all groups/axes and explicit held/undefined leaves. The four Pearson endpoints are a strict subset. Supplementary Methods/Table S1, exact publication-to-source subplot/statistic crosswalk and complete scalar leaf targets remain unresolved; no omitted companion or whole-family average is authorized. Example images, schematics and selected traces are not substitute populations. Required source-native arrays/tables remain outside scalar findings until their original scalar identities can be recovered: all movement/onset traces and distance/coactivity profiles, nearby-stable comparisons, all ten Figure4/S11 comparisons and density/volume/activity distributions; S2 complete amplitude-correlation distributions; S3 quality/density/volume controls; S4 activity/reliability/specificity/coactivity strata; both S5 dendrite strata; S6 session plasticity and all four Chen EGFP controls; S7 six retrospective permutation comparisons; S8 activity/nearest-sLTD/shuffles; S9 coincidence/specificity; S10 complete Kir population; S12 complete absolute-distance bins. Full original behavioral matrices/session series, both EM inputs and all native ART/model/post-hoc/uncertainty outputs also remain required. These are explicit unresolved obligations, not scalar placeholders or permission to omit them.

permitted_observations.description: Use original observed processed-release data, source time/session roles and complete compartment/control/Kir populations. Structural outcomes are observed inputs to retrospective association; S7 conditions on later Middle movement-dendrite labels and is not prospective prediction. Required primitive roles are control, kir, behavior, dual_plane, kir_population, chen_2015, em and basal_kir_distances. Paper+data and paper+data+official-code conditions share the same observations, source support and evaluator; official code is the only information addition. Full public-versus-protected manifests, source version correspondence and actual condition exposure remain unverified.
